lines.trans: What is going on that you called an emergency huddle right here?
Xie Ling's deputy gave me this bracelet and admitted he billed the receipt to a project expense account.
He has barely been here a few days—I knew London Ling could never change his spots!

words.gram: Meaning: refuse to mend one's ways.

lines.trans: Sister Xingzi, what do you mean by that?
Xie Ling has sticky fingers; murky financial dealings inside production budgets go all the way back to ME.
The boss clashed with him over it, which made him resent the boss—that was how their feud began.
Once the boss left ME and nobody could check him, Kaiwen and I were certain his accounts stayed shady.
Great, now we have proof; the chairwoman tolerates zero corruption, so let us go report him right now!
Hold on—I do not think the timing is ripe enough yet.
Look how steady you have become—more and more like the boss!
His deputy also let slip that Xie Ling is bypassing Director Deng to contact network brass directly and kill Charming Voyage.
What is his deal? What on earth is he trying to pull?
